summary.name: PyPodcats
summary.one_liner: PyPodcats is a podcast from the "Hidden Figures of Python" project that features interviews with people in the Python community, hosted by Cheuk, Mariatta, Mojdeh and others.
use_cases: listen to interviews with Python community members
learn about under-recognized contributors to Python
discover diversity and inclusion work in the Python community
catch up on recent PyPodcats episodes
summary.what_it_does: The page lists the latest PyPodcats episodes, including Episode 11 with Sheena O'Connell and Episode 10 with Una Galyeva. It introduces the four hosts, who are Python community figures: Cheuk (PSF fellow and director, Humble Data co-founder), Mariatta (Python Core Developer), Mojdeh (PyLadies Paris co-organizer, PSF Code of Conduct Working Group member) and a host with data leadership and PyLadies Hamburg background. The stated aim is to highlight hidden figures in Python. The page includes a donation prompt for the equipment and stories. It does not describe the format, length, or hosting platforms of episodes beyond this.
notable: Spotlights under-recognized people in the Python community
Hosted by Python Software Foundation fellows and core developers
Videos and podcast episodes, not monetized; funded by donations
caveats: Funded by donations; the page asks for support for equipment
Page does not state podcast hosting platforms or episode schedule
